messages:
maya: heads up — saw three customer tickets where users SSO'd but hit "no role assigned" when trying to open console routes

devon: confirmed. spikes around 09:10 UTC. audit shows role_assigned=null on SAML assertions. collecting traces now.

okta-bot: [INFO] 2025-10-08T09:12:10Z assertion_received user=j.reyes@customer.com attributes_received=[groups] roles_attr=missing

alex: quick repro: Okta assertion contains AttributeStatement with Name="groups" (values like cn=infra-admins) but we expect a "roles" attribute that maps directly to Redwood RBAC roles. RBAC returns 403 when roles missing.

lina: I pushed an Okta mapping change last week (audit id: smb-admin-2025-10-01) to consolidate attributes; looks like the roles mapping got removed in that change.

maya: can we revert? also need short-term mitigation in service so customers aren't blocked.

devon: mitigation proposal (short):
1) rbac-service fallback: if roles claim absent, synthesize roles from groups using prefix mapping
2) re-add roles attribute in Okta mapping (CR needed)
3) add alert when role_assigned=null spikes

alex: sample fallback snippet to add as a quick canary:
```
// fallback: derive roles from groups
if (!claims.roles || claims.roles.length === 0) {
  claims.roles = (claims.groups || []).map(g => {
    if (g.startsWith('cn=infra-admins')) return 'redwood-admin'
    if (g.startsWith('cn=dev-team')) return 'redwood-dev'
    return null
  }).filter(Boolean)
}
```

lina: opening a Change Request in Okta: CR-2025-789 to restore `roles` attribute mapped from `appuser.role`. tagging security-admin for fast-track.

security-oncall: also note—there was an attempted KMS metadata call from a session with role_assigned=null. We should deny KMS access if identity has no role and log with high severity. I'll deploy a fast guard in KMS middleware.

maya: agree. KMS middleware rule: if identity.role == null then return 403 and create high-priority audit event. Coordinate with infra before prod rollout.

devon: i'll push the rbac fallback as a staging canary at 15:00 UTC. test matrix: assertion with roles only, groups only, both; ensure audit shows role_assigned set for all paths.

okta-bot: [ACTION] CR-2025-789 submitted by lina. Status: pending approval.

lina: approval granted. re-enabled roles mapping and pushed test assertion for a user — roles now present in SAML trace.

maya: staged canary looks clean. running regression tests now.

alex: staging checks green. rolling to prod in 10.

security-oncall: KMS guard deployed to prod alongside rbac change. any requests with role==null now denied and logged.

maya: pushing customer comms to affected tickets and closing out incident once support confirms recovery.

devon: follow-ups: add unit tests for fallback mapping, update docs for Okta attribute requirements (roles vs groups), and add metric+alert for role_assigned=null. create postmortem entry: root cause: accidental removal of roles mapping in Okta change.

maya: will draft postmortem and schedule 30-min blameless review. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
